messages:
Maria (runtime): perf-bot just flagged nightly-ci/bench-smallbatch: p95 up ~23% vs baseline. run id 2026-03-17-3507. can someone pick this up?
PerfBot: ALERT: nightly-ci-smallbatch — p95 0.78s -> 0.96s (+21%). artifacts: /artifacts/nightly/3507772222. samples captured: 512.
Aj: i'll take bisect unless someone else is on it. which commit window should I target?
Maria (runtime): between commit abcd1234..abcd9fff, regression surfaced ~04:10 UTC. suspect recent kernel + cache-prefetch combo.
Kai: can we capture kv-cache trace + kernel metrics for the failing run? requesting: `perf-bot capture --run=3507772222 --kv --kernels`
PerfBot: Capture scheduled. artifact upload ETA ~15m.
Rachel: is this reproducible on the smallbatch harness locally? any specific seq length to hit?
Maria (runtime): nightly uses seq=384 for this one. i couldn't repro on my laptop yet — need the runner artifact.
Devon: i'm on infra on-call, checking gpu node pools. no node reboots, but a couple nodes had higher load from other jobs at 04:00. checking kernel change logs + compile flags.
Aj: starting bisect job now. will iterate commits between abcd1234 and abcd9fff. tagging @Rachel for reproducer help.
Rachel: thanks — i'll try a fast repro using the nightly docker image: `redwood/nightly:2026-03-17-3507` and DEBUG_CACHE=1.
Kai: if repro fails locally, please collect `perf top` and `/proc/sched` on the runner. also re-check continuous-batching config (we changed boundary last week).
Maria (runtime): if we confirm it's the kernel path or prefetch boundary, plan is: revert change -> run smallbatch smoke -> promote fix. canary should be held at 5% until cleared.
Devon: i can hold canary. i'll set traffic split 5% and an automatic rollback if p95 > 0.9s for 10m: `ops/traffic split --tier=canary --pct=5 --slo=p95:0.9s`
Aj: bisect job id bisect-3507-1 created. will post hits/fails as they come.
PerfBot: Artifact upload complete: /artifacts/nightly/3507772222/kv-trace.tar.gz (size 48MB).
Rachel: grabbed the trace. early look shows spikes where KV cache misses occur around token 2-4, causing blocking I/O for a few requests.
Maria (runtime): interesting — PR #5123 touched cache prefetching boundaries. could be related.
Kai: FYI PR 5123 moved prefetch threshold for seq >=256 to try and reduce memory thrash. quick revert is plausible if bisect points there.
Aj: bisect results so far: commit abcd5f9 moves p95 back up to regression numbers. confirmed repro with nightly image + `DEBUG_CACHE=1`.
Rachel: reproducer validated. i'll open hotfix PR to revert prefetch boundary and add a perf test for seq 384 smallbatch. link artifacts in PR.
Maria (runtime): :thumbsup: include before/after p95 in the PR description and link the kv-trace. after merge, we'll re-run nightly bench and remove canary hold.
Devon: on it — holding canary and will run the smoke verification: `./ops/smoke-run --target=canary --bench=smallbatch`
Aj: thanks all. i'll keep monitoring bisect and the job logs. tag me for urgent rollbacks. off to watch the bisect run now.
